Job name:    northfield-orders-etl
Type:        Spark (Glue 4.0)
Workers:     G.1X x 5
Script:      s3://northfield-glue-scripts/
             jobs/northfield-orders-etl.py
Source:      northfield_catalog.northfield_orders_raw
Target:      s3://northfield-curated-zone/orders/
Bookmark:    enabled
caption: One Spark job, one raw table in, one curated Parquet output.

code:
curated = (raw
  .withColumn("order_date", to_date(col("order_date")))
  .withColumn("region", upper(trim(col("region"))))
  .withColumn("order_total", col("quantity") * col("unit_price"))
  .dropDuplicates(["order_id"])
)

curated.write.mode("append") \
  .partitionBy("dt").parquet("s3://northfield-curated-zone/orders/")
caption: Typed dates, normalized region, a computed total, deduped.

steps.label: Job bookmarks
steps.sub: only the new dt= partition reprocesses
